recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It is a narrow, non-substantive correction to active Administration module source that finishes the recorded PA resolution without changing conformance behavior or link anchors.
issue_request: FHIR-15792 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5. It identified the Administration module text "Patient Registers / Track people involved in receiving healthcare, the basics nearly everything else references back to" as strange and approved replacing it with "Patient/Person Registries" plus the longer description about people and animals receiving care or associated with those subjects.
initial_application: The original Jira-tagged implementation commit d19ec33e54a1c93b4382a5f43f849bdebfb57bcd updated the descriptive paragraph in source/administration-module.html but left the h4 heading as "Patient Registers", so the issue was only partially applied.
additional_context: PA 2019 Jan WGM minutes page 40731978 records the same wording and a 6-0-0 vote. publish.ini lists administration-module.html under both [pages] and [special-pages], confirming the edited source is active. A later same-page reorganization in commit 5504d434b29697cb190ca56d7b953838fea3695d preserved the section while addressing a different issue and did not supersede FHIR-15792. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary community decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/administration-module.html so the patient-reg h4 now reads "Patient/Person Registries". The already-correct replacement paragraph and existing anchor were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/administration-module.html: changed the patient-reg section heading from "Patient Registers" to "Patient/Person Registries".
